### How to Hear a Heart-Drop
Author: Karen Ehman
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-march-13-2017.html
Passage: Lamentations 2:18
Points:
- People frequently drop subtle clues that disclose their internal loneliness and pain.
- Scripture confirms that the Lord sees our vulnerabilities and hears the cries of our hearts.
- God calls believers to pay attention to others and serve as vessels of His comfort.
- Offering simple, intentional gestures of encouragement lets people know they are genuinely valued.

### Bible Pathway - August 30
Author: Bible Pathway Ministries
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-aug-30-2013.html
Passage: Lamentations 2:14
Points:
- Jerusalem faced divine judgment because false prophets flattered the people rather than exposing their sin.
- Spiritual drifting robs believers of discernment, leaving them vulnerable to deception.
- Worldly temptations disguise destructive traps that lure people away from God.
- Daily prayer and immersion in Scripture are vital for recognizing God's voice and following Him.
- Turning back to the Lord in repentance brings renewal and rest even after failure.
